pedal: Boss PH-3 Phase Shifter, follow-up 2 (mono: Input -> Output)
comment: Step's hold time against Rate (85 ms at 12:00, about 0.35 s at 8:00: neither a fixed time nor a fixed count per cycle); 12 Stage frozen at several sweep points (it is a 6 Stage phaser run twice in series — the model fits worst at the bottom of the sweep); the 8 Stage Res ladder (the loop gain per knob position, in the mode where the loop model is clean) and Res off/on pairs at the same frozen sweep point in 8 and 4 Stage (the 4 Stage Res response has a sag above its top notch that no loop explains: does it move with the sweep?). Rate 7:00 freezes the LFO where it is; a pair = one frozen point, Res 7:00 then 5:00, Rate untouched. Modes in switch order (Step, 12, 8, 4). Clock positions: 7:00 = fully counter-clockwise.

takes.name: step-rate-0900
takes.note: Pedal on, MODE STEP, Depth fully up (big jumps are easier to see).

takes.name: step-rate-1030
takes.note: Rate to about 10:30 (half-way between 9:00 and 12:00; needn't be exact).

takes.name: step-depth-0700
takes.note: Rate 12:00, Depth fully down: does Step still step, or sit still?

takes.name: step-rate-1200
takes.note: Depth back up: the 85 ms reference again, same session as the other Rates.
